name: BDH Industries Limited
about: BDH Industries Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of therapeutic formulations for pharmaceuticals in India and Internationally. The company operates in two segments, Pharmaceuticals and Renewable Energy. It offers finished pharmaceuticals products, such as analgesic antipyretic, analgesic balm, antacids, acaricide, anthelmintics, antiprotozoal, aniti-glaucoma, antiseptics, anti-psychotics, anti-tuberculosis, anti-allergics, anti-tussive, antiasthamatics, antibacterial, antiseptic, anticancer, anticoagulants, anticonvulsants, antidiabetics, anti-emetics, antifungal, antigout, antimalaraial, antiparkinsonisms, antispasmodics, antiulcers, and antivirals. The company also provides sedative, anxiolytic, antidepressants, calcium suppliments, cardiovascular, carminative, aromatic, corticosteroids, diuretics, electrolyte replinishers, expectorant, iron supplimentry, laxatives, local anesthetic, general anesthetics, mydriatics, narcotic-analgesics, non-steroidal anti-inflammatory products, rubefacient and mild analgesics, skin protective, skin smoothner, vitamins, pharmaceutical aid, and drugs acting on uterus products. In addition, it offers alkay-er tablets; morphine sulphate slow-release tablets; rilimorf; sulfasalazine delayed release tablets; indomethacin extended-release capsules; and Sildenafil citrate tablet. Further, the company owns two wind turbines with a capacity of 1.6 MW, located in Jaisalmer in Rajasthan. BDH Industries Limited was founded in 1935 and is based in Mumbai, India.
